_key_rule: Hotkeys (meta binds) use prefix 'input_' (input_config_get_prefix, configuration.c L8418). A joypad button is input_<base>_btn = "<n>", an axis input_<base>_axis = "+<n>" / "-<n>", unbound "nul" (save_keybind_joykey L8288, save_keybind_axis L8326). The keyboard (input_<base>) and mouse (input_<base>_mbtn) binds are separate keys and are not managed.
_enable_rule: While input_enable_hotkey is bound, every other hotkey needs it held (input_hotkey_blocked L12083, input_keys_pressed L13561, input/input_driver.c). So a RetroArch hotkey is always <enable> + <action>, with one enable input shared by all hotkeys, including the ones map-helper doesn't manage.

emudeck_enable._source: EmuDeck's retroarch.cfg template @ dddb302 L243-246 (tests/fixtures/retroarch/emudeck-default/retroarch.cfg): Select. `show` calls a live value equal to it EmuDeck's.

_targets_notes: Bases are the names in input_config_bind_map (configuration.c L347-467). hotkey.fast_forward is the toggle in every emulator (owner's decision, 2026-10-22), as EmuDeck binds Select+R2 (input_toggle_fast_forward_axis = "+5" in tests/fixtures/retroarch/emudeck-default/retroarch.cfg); hotkey.fast_forward_hold is the hold variant.

quit_combo._notes: Not managed, only read: a gamepad combo that quits regardless of the exit hotkey. Index = enum input_combo_type (input/input_defines.h L221-235; 0 = INPUT_COMBO_NONE), checked in input_driver.c L2221. EmuDeck sets "4" (Start+Select).

_meta_bases_notes: Every DECLARE_META_BIND base in input_config_bind_map (configuration.c L388-466), in order. Only read, to warn when an unmanaged hotkey shares a button with one we write.

sdl2._source: input/drivers_joypad/sdl2_joypad.c (ident "sdl2", L669): a pad SDL knows as a game controller is opened with SDL_GameControllerOpen (sdl2_pad_connect L121-125) and exposes SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_MAX buttons and SDL_CONTROLLER_AXIS_MAX axes (L181-194). sdl2_pad_get_button passes the bind index straight to SDL_GameControllerGetButton (L59-65) and sdl2_pad_get_axis to SDL_GameControllerGetAxis (L81-97), so indices are SDL's SDL_GameControllerButton (SDL_gamecontroller.h L731-755) and SDL_GameControllerAxis (L620-630) enums.
sdl2._notes: Cross-checked against EmuDeck's retroarch.cfg (enable_hotkey 4 = Back, exit 6 = Start, save 10 = R1, load 9 = L1, slot -/+ 13/14 = D-left/right, rewind +4 = L2, fast-forward +5 = R2) and the sdl2 'Steam Virtual Gamepad.cfg' autoconfig (input_l_y_minus_axis = "-1" = left stick up). SDL's MISC1 (15), PADDLE1-4 (16-19) and TOUCHPAD (20) are left out: the Steam virtual pad is an Xbox 360 pad and has none of them, so a hotkey there would never fire. guide = 5 is [VERIFY]: Steam keeps the Guide/PS button for itself. Holds only while SDL sees the pad as a game controller (the Steam virtual pad is in SDL's mapping database) [VERIFY on a Deck].
